breakpoints.name: next-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Next-only max-width query; below 768px. Shared client primitives are unchanged.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Canonical primary button; dark theme specimen.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-family:Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.25rem;padding:6px 12px;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}.ds-button{background:var(--wn-brand-500, #335dff);color:var(--wn-white,#ffffff);}.ds-button:hover{background:var(--wn-brand-600,#2a4ecc);}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wn-brand-500,#335dff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Canonical secondary button; dark theme specimen.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-family:Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.25rem;padding:6px 12px;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}.ds-button{background:transparent;color:var(--wn-zinc-300,#d4d4d8);border:1px solid var(--wn-zinc-700,#3f3f46);}.ds-button:hover{background:var(--wn-zinc-800,#27272a);color:var(--wn-zinc-100,#f4f4f5);}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wn-brand-500,#335dff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Canonical ghost button; dark theme specimen.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-family:Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;padding:6px 12px;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}.ds-button{background:transparent;color:var(--wn-zinc-400,#a1a1aa);}.ds-button:hover{background:var(--wn-zinc-800,#27272a);color:var(--wn-zinc-100,#f4f4f5);}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wn-brand-500,#335dff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-input{padding:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:6px;background:var(--wn-zinc-950,#09090b);color:var(--wn-zinc-50,#fafafa);font-family:Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:13px;transition:border-color 150ms}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--wn-brand-500,#335dff)}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Metadata badge
components.description: Next.js platform metadata, noninteractive; uppercase rendering is inherited.
components.css: .ds-badge{display:inline-block;font-family:Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}

components.name: Sidebar navigation
components.description: Shared collection section specimen. Next narrow explorer is a left overlay, max-width 90vw; selection closes it. React behavior is not simulated.
components.css: .ds-nav{width:280px;padding:12px;background:var(--wn-zinc-900,#18181b);color:var(--wn-zinc-50,#fafafa);font-family:Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}.ds-nav button{display:block;margin-top:8px;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:13px;text-align:left;width:100%;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms ease}.ds-nav button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:var(--wn-zinc-50,#fafafa)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #335dff;outline-offset:2px}.ds-nav strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-nav{max-width:90vw}}

components.name: Panel surface
components.description: Shared frontmatter shell. Next narrow frontmatter starts closed and opens as a right overlay, max-width 90vw. React behavior is not simulated.
components.css: .ds-panel{width:320px;background:var(--wn-zinc-900,#18181b);color:var(--wn-zinc-50,#fafafa);font-family:Plus Jakarta Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}.ds-panel strong{display:block;padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}.ds-panel p{padding:12px;color:var(--wn-zinc-500,#71717a)}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-panel{max-width:90vw}}

narrative.overview:
A calm, practical writing workspace with compact controls, rounded boundaries, blue accents, and generous room for content. The writing canvas leads; navigation and document tools form a restrained frame around it.

The Next.js integration inherits the Astro editor’s dark-first shell, collection navigation, frontmatter panel, fluid prose typography, and scoped light-mode overrides. Shared client source is reused through build aliases, while this package ships its own assets and identifies the platform as Next.js. This Operate extension preserves the incumbent visual world; the inherited metaphor and descriptive language remain provisional defaults pending user feedback, rather than newly established brand commitments.
keyCharacteristics: Blue brand accents with zinc interface neutrals.
Compact rounded controls around an expansive writing surface.
Explicit hover, focus, disabled, and document-status treatments.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Keep status meaning consistent across indicators and destructive actions.

dos: Do preserve the shared brand palette while respecting this target’s theme implementation.
Do keep prose and code typography distinct.
Do retain keyboard focus and disabled states when extending controls.
donts: Don’t replace semantic status colors with decorative accents.
Don’t copy theme selectors or spacing-token names across targets without checking their definitions.
Don’t treat archival screenshots as authority over current component source.
